description.summary: Forming a harmonic configuration of cymbals and drums, you surround the creature in a defensive structure of instruments and sound.
description.value: Forming a harmonic configuration of cymbals and drums, you surround the creature in a defensive structure of instruments and sound. The subject is surrounded by shifting obstacles, granting the subject concealment (20% miss chance). Though the subject is not harshly affected by the instruments as they move in a way that does not hinder them. A see invisibility spell does not counteract this effect, but a true seeing spell does. Opponents that cannot see the subject ignore the song’s effect (though fighting an unseen opponent carries penalties of its own).
